From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Kowalski <anna.kowalski@clearwave.com>
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 08:00:00 -0700
Subject: Scheduling: SOC 2 + DPA + pen-test walkthrough (Redwood)

Hi Anna,

Thanks again for agreeing to a combined intake call to cover the SOC 2 controls review, DPA scope, and pen-test logistics for ClearWave's Redwood integration. To accommodate your ops and security teams, could you confirm which of the following evening (CET) windows would work for you and your pen vendor?

- Option A: Tue 9/7 18:00-19:15 CET (09:00-10:15 PT)
- Option B: Wed 9/8 20:00-21:15 CET (11:00-12:15 PT)
- Option C: Thu 9/9 19:30-20:45 CET (10:30-11:45 PT)

Agenda (high level):
- 15m: introductions & account context
- 30m: SOC 2 controls mapping + evidence handoff
- 20m: DPA questions & redline path
- 10m: Pen-test scope, timeline, vendor coordination

Attached is a short evidence checklist and a proposed agenda PDF for your review. If you prefer a shorter 45–60m slot, say so and we’ll compress.

Who from ClearWave should be on the call (security, compliance, pen vendor)? Also, do you prefer using a Redwood-hosted Bridge or a customer Zoom? We can open a DocuSign envelope for the DPA draft if you want to review before the call.

Thanks,

Mina Haddad
Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: evidence-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet), proposed-agenda.pdf (pdf)
From: Anna Kowalski <anna.kowalski@clearwave.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 19:10:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Scheduling: SOC 2 + DPA + pen-test walkthrough (Redwood)

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the options. Our team is tight that week; earliest we can do is an evening slot. Option B (Wed 9/8 20:00 CET) would be best for our security and aligns with Pentek's availability (cc’d). A couple notes:

- Please make the call start promptly at 20:00 CET; the pen vendor only has a 75m window.
- For the DPA, legal asked if you can share the current draft in advance — we can do redlines during the call but prefer to have a copy beforehand.
- We prefer to use our Zoom (I’ll send a meeting link once time is confirmed).

Attendees:
- Anna Kowalski (Security Lead) — ClearWave
- secops@clearwave.com (SOC team)
- Pen vendor (Pentek) — pen-tests@pentek.io

If Redwood needs extra time to cover SOC 2 control mappings, note we can split into two 45m sessions next week.

Best,
Anna
